_comment: K50 Ultra (diting, SM8475/cape) board facts. One source of truth for mkadt-diting.py, diting-extract.py and the retarget tool. Every value carries where it came from; values marked pending need the phone's own live FDT (docs/DEVICE-DUMP.md) before they can be trusted.

identity.note: xiaomi,sweet must stay: pexpert/SweetPE matches IONameMatch 'xiaomi,sweet' (0016). D22AP first still gives hw.model=iPhone10,3.

memory.source: lineage-diting-dt/qcom/cape-reserved-memory.dtsi + K60 MEMORY-PLAN.md; DRAM banks themselves pending live FDT
memory.note: Same p0 window as K60: 0xb4000000 + 703 MiB, top at 0xe0000000 just below gunyah. dram-size = window - panic log (1 MiB). Requires diting's live FDT to have DRAM covering this span; verify with `diting-extract.py fdt`.
memory.notches_note: Identical to K60 0184. Keep 0xb9200000 end even though diting's splash region is 0x2b00000: it costs 6 MiB and avoids a notch that ends inside ABL's scan-out.

cpu.cores_comment: 1x Cortex-X2 + 3x A710 + 4x A510, ARMv9, PAC off in this build (same CAPE.h as K60)

gic.source: cape.dtsi intc node + xnu/cape/CAPE.h (same SoC as K60)

timer.source: cape.dtsi arch_timer; standard PPI numbering, CNTV = 16 + 11 = 27

ufs.status: shim read/write proven on K60; diting untested

display.splash_region_note: lineage-diting-dt/qcom/display/display/cape-sde-display.dtsi: reg = <0x0 0xb8000000 0x0 0x02b00000>, label cont_splash_region. Same base as K60, so shim/console.h keeps FB_BASE.

panels.name: xiaomi 42 02 0a mp cmd mode dsc dsi panel
xiaomi 36 02 0b mp cmd mode dsc dsi panel

display.panel_selection: pending: the bootloader/DT picks 42 or 36 by DDIC id at runtime; both are 1220x2712. Normal boot draws into ABL's splash buffer, so panel init only matters for the DSI debug paths (K60_NODSC/K60_RAWFB).
display.lcd_name_source: cape-sde-display.dtsi also sets qcom,dsi-default-panel=<&dsi_r66451_amoled_video> (1080x2400); that node is NOT the retail diting panel, ignore it.
display.panel_selected_note: provisional: both L12 panels are 1220x2712 and only the DSI debug replay uses this sequence; override with DITING_PANEL=l12-36-02-0b if the log shows the 36 02 0b DDIC.

touch.driver_hint: node compatible 'xiaomi,l12-spi'; Xiaomi's driver carries both goodix,* and fts,* property sets, so the chip may be Goodix GT99xx or FocalTech. Goodix ID read first; if it fails, dump the ID register before assuming the protocol.
touch.source: diting-kernel/qcom/diting-sm8475.dtsi + qcom/diting-pinctrl.dtsi (pins gpio16-18 func qup4, gpio19 qup4), cape-regulators.dtsi L2C
touch.status: pins/bus/rails are identical to K60; the K60 RSC blocker will very likely apply here too (same 0x17a00000 block)

keys.source: cape-mtp.dtsi gpio-keys vol_up + K60 0251 (same PMIC generation)

wifi_mac_note: Synthetic. MobileGestalt reads /chosen/mac-address-wifi0 first; without it lsd blocks forever on a semaphore (see mkadt.py comment).
pending: live FDT (or dtbo.img) from the user's unit: confirms DRAM banks, reserved-memory regs, which L12 panel variant is active, and whether cont_splash_region is at 0xb8000000 after the board overlay
touch controller vendor (Goodix vs FocalTech): read chip id once the RSC/GENI path works
whether ABL leaves the panel scanning (K60 does; diting expected, unproven)

firmware.package: K50 Ultra port of Xiaomi 14 Ultra OS1.0.24 (full fastboot ROM)
firmware.base_dtb: board/base.dtb, extracted from vendor_boot.img dtb section at 0x16a3000 and trimmed to its FDT totalsize (480704 bytes)
firmware.note: ABL fills /memory at boot (static reg is 0,0), so DRAM size still needs the live FDT; everything else below is confirmed from this package.

verified.splash_region: 0xb8000000 + 0x2b00000 in 38 of 44 dtbo overlays (node splash_region, label cont_splash_region)
verified.reserved_memory: matches the notches below: xbl_sc 0xa6e00000+0x40000, global_sync 0xa6f00000+0x100000, qheebsp 0xe0000000+0x600000, cpusys_vm 0xe0600000+0x400000, hyp_reserved 0xe0a00000+0x100000
verified.panels_present: dtbo carries both qcom,mdss_dsi_l12_42_02_0a_dsc_cmd and qcom,mdss_dsi_l12_36_02_0b_dsc_cmd; which one ABL binds is still runtime-only
verified.gunyah_above_window: trust_ui_vm/tz_stat/tags/qtee reservations run 0xe0b00000-0xea000000, all above the 0xe0000000 window top
